title: Medication interaction and side-effect check across a household
description: Review a household's combined medication list for potential interactions or side effects worth raising with a pharmacist or doctor.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: medication-interaction-check
  title: Medication interaction and side-effect check across a household
  description: Review a household's combined medication list for potential interactions or side effects worth raising with a pharmacist or doctor.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Flag potential medication interactions or side effects across a household's medication list so the family can raise the right questions with a pharmacist or doctor, without recommending any change to medication.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Household medication list
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The list of medications, supplements, and dosages currently taken by each household member. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Interaction researcher
      role: Careful researcher on general medication interaction and side-effect information.
      prompt: Research general, publicly known information about potential interactions and common side effects among the medications and supplements listed for this household. Never suggest stopping, starting, or changing the dose of any medication, and never diagnose any condition. Present only possibilities to be aware of, and state clearly that a pharmacist or doctor must review the actual regimen before any decision is made.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, clinical-review], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: flag-concerns
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Interaction and urgency flagger
      role: Cautious flagger of potential medication concerns, biased toward escalating when uncertain.
      prompt: Based on the researcher's findings, flag potential interactions or side effects and assign an urgency level of none, discuss-with-pharmacist, or contact-doctor-promptly. Do not recommend stopping, starting, or changing any medication yourself; only identify what should be raised with a pharmacist or doctor and why. When evidence is ambiguous, escalate to the more cautious level rather than dismissing the concern.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation, clinical-review], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [score, passed, reasons]
        properties:
          score: { type: number }
          passed: { type: boolean }
          reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: route
      kind: condition
      name: Route by concern level
      config:
        expression: "flag-concerns.reasons"
        branches:
          - { label: No concern found, when: none }
          - { label: Discuss with pharmacist, when: discuss-with-pharmacist }
          - { label: Contact doctor promptly, when: contact-doctor-promptly }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Medication concerns to raise with a professional
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: researcher, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: researcher, to: flag-concerns, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: flag-concerns, to: route, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: route, to: result, kind: control, condition: none }
    - { id: e5, from: route, to: result, kind: control, condition: discuss-with-pharmacist }
    - { id: e6, from: route, to: result, kind: control, condition: contact-doctor-promptly }
